2025-12-29.headline: Intel gets hands on Nvidia’s $5B investment
2025-12-29.summary: Intel has completed the sale of over 214.7 million shares of its common stock to Nvidia for $5 billion, as part of an investment initially announced in mid-September. This investment is tied to a joint development agreement for custom data center and PC hardware, including integrating Intel's x86 CPUs with Nvidia AI infrastructure platforms and producing x86 SOCs with Nvidia RTX GPU chiplets for PCs. This comes after a significant U.S. government investment in Intel and reflects Intel's aggressive reorientation of its operations.
